name: @harness/protocol
description: Shared event, config and API types (and JSON schemas) for the CDR harness.

scripts.schema: ts-json-schema-generator -p src/index.ts -t HarnessEvent --no-type-check -o schema/events.schema.json && ts-json-schema-generator -p src/index.ts -t HarnessConfig --no-type-check -o schema/config.schema.json
